<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="ru">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
  <title>Куда пойти заниматься в Нерюнгри — спортивные школы и секции</title>
  <meta name="description" content="Каталог спортивных школ и секций Нерюнгри: фильтр по виду спорта, возрасту и типу учреждения.">
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
  <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Golos+Text:wght@400;500;600&family=Unbounded:wght@500;700;800&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
  <style>
:root{
  --snow:#eaf0f3; --paper:#fff; --ink:#122633; --ink-2:#1c3a4d; --steel:#5a7080; --line:#cfdbe2;
  --ice:#d9ecf4; --signal:#ff5a1f; --signal-d:#c93d0a;
  --display:"Unbounded","Arial Black","Segoe UI",system-ui,sans-serif;
  --body:"Golos Text","Segoe UI",system-ui,-apple-system,Roboto,Arial,sans-serif;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{font-family:var(--body);font-size:16px;background:var(--snow);color:var(--ink);line-height:1.55}
body.no-scroll{overflow:hidden}
img{display:block;max-width:100%}
button,input,select{font:inherit;color:inherit}
button{cursor:pointer}
a{color:inherit}
:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--signal-d);outline-offset:2px}
.container{width:min(1180px,100% - 32px);margin-inline:auto}

/* ---------- Hero ---------- */
.hero{background:var(--ink);color:#fff;overflow:hidden}
.hero__grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.05fr 1fr;gap:32px;align-items:stretch;min-height:480px}
.hero__text{padding:36px 0 56px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:center}
.brand{font-family:var(--display);font-weight:700;font-size:1rem;color:var(--ice);margin-bottom:auto;padding-bottom:40px}
.hero h1{font-family:var(--display);font-weight:800;font-size:clamp(2rem,4.4vw,3.4rem);line-height:1.12;letter-spacing:-.01em;max-width:13em}
.hero__lead{margin-top:20px;max-width:30em;font-size:1.08rem;color:#c3d6e0}
.cta{display:inline-block;margin-top:30px;padding:16px 38px 16px 30px;background:var(--signal);color:var(--ink);font-weight:600;text-decoration:none;border:0;
  clip-path:polygon(0 0,100% 0,calc(100% - 14px) 100%,0 100%);transition:background .15s}
.cta:hover{background:#ff7a47}
.cta--dark{background:var(--ink);color:#fff}
.cta--dark:hover{background:var(--ink-2)}

/* Пьедестал из фотографий */
.podium{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:flex-end;padding-top:32px}
.strip{position:relative;flex:0 0 36%;margin-left:-7%;clip-path:polygon(22% 0,100% 0,78% 100%,0 100%);overflow:hidden;background:var(--ink-2);
  animation:rise 1s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1) both}
.strip img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}
.strip::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:auto 0 0;height:45%;background:linear-gradient(transparent,rgba(18,38,51,.85))}
.strip figcaption{position:absolute;z-index:1;left:26%;bottom:18px;font-family:var(--display);font-weight:700;font-size:.95rem}
.strip--1{height:100%;z-index:2;animation-delay:.15s}
.strip--2{height:80%;animation-delay:0s}
.strip--3{height:62%;animation-delay:.3s}
@keyframes rise{from{transform:translateY(60%);opacity:0}to{transform:none;opacity:1}}

.hazard{height:14px;background:repeating-linear-gradient(135deg,var(--signal) 0 14px,var(--ink) 14px 28px)}

/* ---------- Панель фильтров ---------- */
.panel{background:var(--paper);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:6px;margin-top:-1px;padding:22px 24px 20px;display:grid;gap:22px}
.panel>*{min-width:0}
.panel__row{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:16px 24px;align-items:flex-end}
.search{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;flex:1 1 220px;min-width:200px;border-bottom:2px solid var(--ink);padding:8px 2px}
.search input{border:0;outline:0;background:none;width:100%;font-size:1rem}
.search:focus-within{border-color:var(--signal-d)}
.ctl{display:grid;gap:6px}
.ctl__name{font-size:.82rem;color:var(--steel);font-weight:500}

.seg{display:inline-flex;border:2px solid var(--ink);border-radius:4px;overflow:hidden}
.seg button{border:0;background:none;padding:8px 14px;font-size:.9rem;font-weight:500;transition:background .15s,color .15s}
.seg button+button{border-left:2px solid var(--ink)}
.seg button:hover{background:var(--ice)}
.seg button.on{background:var(--ink);color:#fff}
.seg--small button{padding:5px 11px;font-size:.82rem}

.stepper{display:inline-flex;border:2px solid var(--ink);border-radius:4px;overflow:hidden}
.stepper button{width:38px;border:0;background:none;font-size:1.25rem;line-height:1}
.stepper button:hover{background:var(--ice)}
.stepper input{width:76px;text-align:center;border:0;border-inline:2px solid var(--ink);outline:0;font-weight:600;font-size:1rem;-moz-appearance:textfield;background:#fff}
.stepper input::-webkit-outer-spin-button,.stepper input::-webkit-inner-spin-button{-webkit-appearance:none}
.stepper:focus-within{border-color:var(--signal-d)}
.stepper:focus-within input{border-color:var(--signal-d)}

.reset{margin-left:auto;background:none;border:0;color:var(--signal-d);font-weight:600;padding:8px 0;text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:3px}
.reset:hover{color:var(--ink)}

.picker__head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:10px}
.picker h2{font-family:var(--display);font-size:1.1rem;font-weight:700}
.tabs{display:flex;gap:4px;overflow-x:auto;border-bottom:2px solid var(--line);scrollbar-width:thin}
.tab{flex:0 0 auto;background:none;border:0;padding:10px 14px;font-weight:500;color:var(--steel);position:relative;display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;white-space:nowrap}
.tab:hover{color:var(--ink)}
.tab.on{color:var(--ink);font-weight:600}
.tab.on::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:-2px;height:4px;background:var(--signal)}
.tab__n{background:var(--ink);color:#fff;border-radius:999px;min-width:20px;height:20px;padding:0 6px;font-size:.75rem;display:grid;place-items:center}
.chips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;padding-top:16px;min-height:62px}
.chip{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;border:2px solid var(--ink);background:#fff;border-radius:4px;padding:7px 14px;font-weight:500;transition:background .12s,color .12s}
.chip small{font-size:.75rem;color:var(--steel);font-weight:600}
.chip:hover{background:var(--ice)}
.chip.on{background:var(--ink);color:#fff}
.chip.on small{color:var(--ice)}

/* ---------- Результаты ---------- */
.results{padding:34px 0 64px}
.results__bar{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-end;gap:16px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.results__bar h2{font-family:var(--display);font-weight:500;font-size:1.15rem}
.results__bar h2 b{font-size:2.4rem;font-weight:800;color:var(--signal-d);margin-right:4px}
.sort{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;font-size:.88rem;color:var(--steel)}
.sort select{border:2px solid var(--ink);border-radius:4px;padding:6px 10px;background:#fff;font-weight:500}
.active-tags{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;margin:14px 0 4px}
.active-tags:empty{display:none}
.active-tag{display:inline-flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;background:var(--signal);color:var(--ink);border:0;border-radius:4px;padding:4px 10px;font-size:.86rem;font-weight:600}
.active-tag i{font-style:normal;font-size:1.1rem;line-height:1}
.active-tag:hover{background:#ff7a47}

.list{display:grid;gap:18px;margin-top:20px}
.row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:300px 1fr 130px;background:var(--paper);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:6px;overflow:hidden;cursor:pointer;
  transition:border-color .15s}
.row:hover{border-color:var(--ink)}
.row__photo{position:relative;background:var(--ice);clip-path:polygon(0 0,100% 0,calc(100% - 38px) 100%,0 100%)}
.row__photo{min-height:230px}
.row__photo img{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}
.row__main{padding:20px 22px 18px 6px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px;min-width:0}
.row__head{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:6px 12px}
.row__head h3{font-family:var(--display);font-weight:700;font-size:1.4rem;line-height:1.2}
.row__n{font-size:.88rem;color:var(--steel)}
.kind{display:inline-block;padding:2px 10px;border-radius:3px;font-size:.8rem;font-weight:600}
.kind--municipal{background:var(--ink);color:#fff}
.kind--private{background:#fff;color:var(--signal-d);border:2px solid var(--signal)}
.row__desc{color:#34505f;font-size:.95rem;max-width:62ch}
.tags{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px}
.tag{background:var(--snow);border-radius:3px;padding:2px 9px;font-size:.82rem;font-weight:500}
.tag.hit{background:var(--signal);color:var(--ink);font-weight:600}
.tag--more{background:none;border:1px dashed var(--steel);color:var(--steel)}
.row__actions{margin-top:auto;padding-top:6px;display:flex;gap:20px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap}
.open{font-weight:600;text-decoration:underline;text-decoration-color:var(--signal);text-decoration-thickness:3px;text-underline-offset:5px}
.ext{font-size:.9rem;color:var(--steel)}
.ext:hover{color:var(--signal-d)}

/* возраст как номер на майке */
.age{background:var(--ice);display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;text-align:center;line-height:1;padding:14px 8px;clip-path:polygon(22px 0,100% 0,100% 100%,0 100%)}
.age small{font-size:.85rem;color:var(--steel);font-weight:500;margin-bottom:2px}
.age b{font-family:var(--display);font-weight:800;font-size:3.6rem;color:var(--ink);letter-spacing:-.04em}
.age span{font-size:.9rem;color:var(--steel);font-weight:500;margin-top:4px}
.age--unknown b{color:var(--signal-d)}
.age--unknown span{line-height:1.25}

.empty{background:var(--paper);border:2px dashed var(--steel);border-radius:6px;padding:48px 24px;text-align:center;margin-top:20px}
.empty[hidden]{display:none}
.empty h3{font-family:var(--display);font-size:1.3rem;margin-bottom:8px}
.empty p{color:var(--steel);max-width:34em;margin-inline:auto}
.empty .cta{margin-top:22px}

/* ---------- Окно с подробностями ---------- */
dialog{border:0;border-radius:6px;padding:0;width:min(900px,calc(100% - 24px));max-height:calc(100vh - 32px);margin:auto;overflow:auto;background:var(--paper);color:var(--ink);box-shadow:0 30px 80px rgba(0,0,0,.4)}
dialog::backdrop{background:rgba(18,38,51,.72)}
dialog[open]{animation:pop .22s ease}
@keyframes pop{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(12px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
.modal__body{display:grid;grid-template-columns:300px 1fr;position:relative;min-height:420px}
.modal__close{position:absolute;top:10px;right:12px;z-index:3;width:38px;height:38px;border:2px solid var(--ink);background:#fff;border-radius:4px;font-size:1.5rem;line-height:1}
.modal__close:hover{background:var(--signal)}
.modal__photo{background:var(--ice);clip-path:polygon(0 0,100% 0,calc(100% - 44px) 100%,0 100%)}
.modal__photo{position:relative}
.modal__photo img{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}
.modal__content{padding:28px 30px 30px 8px}
.modal__content h2{font-family:var(--display);font-weight:800;font-size:2rem;line-height:1.15;margin:10px 0 8px}
.modal__desc{color:#34505f;max-width:60ch}
.modal__content h4{font-family:var(--display);font-weight:700;font-size:.95rem;margin:24px 0 10px}
.sport-list{list-style:none;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(230px,1fr));gap:8px}
.sport-list li{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;align-items:baseline;border-left:4px solid var(--line);background:var(--snow);padding:7px 12px;font-size:.92rem}
.sport-list li b{font-size:.82rem;font-weight:600;color:var(--steel);text-align:right;white-space:nowrap}
.sport-list li.hit{border-left-color:var(--signal);background:#ffe6dc}
.sport-list em{font-style:normal;color:var(--steel);font-size:.82rem}
.plain{padding-left:20px;display:grid;gap:6px;font-size:.93rem}
.contacts{list-style:none;display:grid;gap:6px}
.contacts a{font-weight:600;text-decoration-color:var(--signal);text-decoration-thickness:3px;text-underline-offset:4px}

.footer{background:var(--ink);color:#a9c0cc;padding:26px 0;font-size:.88rem}

/* ---------- Адаптив ---------- */
@media (max-width:940px){
  .hero__grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;min-height:0}
  .hero__text{padding-bottom:12px}
  .brand{padding-bottom:28px}
  .podium{height:230px;padding-top:0;justify-content:center}
  .strip{flex-basis:38%}
  .strip figcaption{font-size:.8rem;bottom:12px}
  .row{grid-template-columns:240px 1fr 100px}
  .age b{font-size:2.8rem}
}
@media (max-width:700px){
  .panel{padding:18px 16px}
  .reset{margin-left:0}
  .row{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .row__photo{clip-path:polygon(0 0,100% 0,100% calc(100% - 22px),0 100%);height:190px}
  .row__main{padding:16px 18px 16px}
  .age{flex-direction:row;gap:8px;align-items:baseline;justify-content:flex-start;padding:10px 18px;clip-path:none}
  .age b{font-size:2rem}
  .age small,.age span{margin:0}
  .age--unknown span br{display:none}
  .modal__body{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .modal__photo{height:190px;clip-path:polygon(0 0,100% 0,100% calc(100% - 22px),0 100%)}
  .modal__content{padding:16px 20px 24px}
  .modal__content h2{font-size:1.6rem}
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*{animation:none!important;transition:none!important}}

/* Заглушка вместо фото */
.ph{position:absolute;inset:0;display:grid;place-content:center;justify-items:center;gap:6px;color:var(--ice);
  background:repeating-linear-gradient(135deg,var(--ink-2) 0 18px,#183344 18px 36px)}
.ph span{font-family:var(--display);font-weight:800;font-size:4.5rem;line-height:1;opacity:.9}
.ph small{font-size:.82rem;opacity:.75}

</style>
</head>
<body>

<header class="hero">
  <div class="container hero__grid">
    <div class="hero__text">
      <p class="brand">Спорт Нерюнгри</p>
      <h1>Куда пойти заниматься в&nbsp;Нерюнгри</h1>
      <p class="hero__lead" id="heroLead">Школы и клубы города в одном списке. Выберите вид спорта и возраст — покажем, где набирают.</p>
      <a class="cta" href="#catalog">Подобрать секцию</a>
    </div>

    <div class="podium" aria-hidden="true">
      <figure class="strip strip--2"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="" style="object-position:40% 50%"><figcaption>Шахтёр</figcaption></figure>
      <figure class="strip strip--1"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="" style="object-position:55% 50%"><figcaption>Лидер</figcaption></figure>
      <figure class="strip strip--3"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="" style="object-position:50% 25%"><figcaption>Панчер</figcaption></figure>
    </div>
  </div>
</header>
<div class="hazard" aria-hidden="true"></div>

<main class="container" id="catalog">

  <section class="panel" aria-label="Фильтры">
    <div class="panel__row">
      <label class="search">
        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="18" height="18" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="7" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M16.5 16.5 21 21" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>
        <input type="search" id="search" placeholder="Название школы" aria-label="Поиск по названию">
      </label>

      <div class="ctl">
        <span class="ctl__name" id="typeLabel">Тип</span>
        <div class="seg" id="typeFilter" role="radiogroup" aria-labelledby="typeLabel">
          <button type="button" role="radio" aria-checked="true"  data-value="all" class="on">Все</button>
          <button type="button" role="radio" aria-checked="false" data-value="municipal">Муниципальные</button>
          <button type="button" role="radio" aria-checked="false" data-value="private">Частные</button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="ctl">
        <span class="ctl__name" id="ageLabel">Возраст</span>
        <div class="stepper" role="group" aria-labelledby="ageLabel">
          <button type="button" id="ageMinus" aria-label="Меньше">−</button>
          <input type="number" id="age" min="0" max="99" placeholder="любой" inputmode="numeric" aria-label="Возраст в годах">
          <button type="button" id="agePlus" aria-label="Больше">+</button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <button class="reset" id="resetBtn" type="button">Сбросить всё</button>
    </div>

    <div class="picker">
      <div class="picker__head">
        <h2>Вид спорта</h2>
        <div class="seg seg--small" id="matchMode" role="radiogroup" aria-label="Режим выбора">
          <button type="button" role="radio" aria-checked="true"  data-value="any" class="on">Любой из выбранных</button>
          <button type="button" role="radio" aria-checked="false" data-value="all">Все сразу</button>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="tabs" id="tabs" role="tablist" aria-label="Категории"></div>
      <div class="chips" id="chips" role="tabpanel"></div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <section class="results" aria-live="polite">
    <div class="results__bar">
      <h2 id="count"></h2>
      <div class="sort">
        <label for="sort">Сортировка</label>
        <select id="sort">
          <option value="name">По названию</option>
          <option value="sports">По числу секций</option>
          <option value="age">По возрасту набора</option>
        </select>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div id="activeTags" class="active-tags"></div>
    <div id="list" class="list"></div>

    <div id="empty" class="empty" hidden>
      <h3>Под такие условия школ нет</h3>
      <p>Уберите часть фильтров или выберите другой вид спорта — результаты обновятся сразу.</p>
      <button type="button" class="cta cta--dark" id="emptyReset">Сбросить фильтры</button>
    </div>
  </section>
</main>

<dialog id="modal">
  <article class="modal__body" id="modalBody"></article>
</dialog>

<footer class="footer">
  <div class="container">
    <p>Информация собрана из открытых источников. Расписание, цены и условия набора уточняйте у школ.</p>
  </div>
</footer>

<script>
const IMG = {
  booltur: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  cheernrg: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  erel: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  fenix: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  krol: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  kyokushin: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  lider: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  lovivolnu: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  puncher: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  shakhter: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  typhoon: "data:image/jpeg;base64,"
};

/* ============================================================
   Данные о спортивных школах Нерюнгри
   sports: [{ n: вид спорта, min: мин. возраст набора (null — не указан),
              max: макс. возраст (null — не ограничен), t: текст про возраст }]
   ============================================================ */
const CATEGORIES = {
  "Единоборства":        ["бокс", "кикбоксинг", "вольная борьба", "самбо", "боевое самбо", "джиу-джитсу", "ушу", "карате", "киокушинкай", "ММА"],
  "Силовые виды":        ["пауэрлифтинг", "тяжёлая атлетика", "гиревой спорт", "кроссфит", "бодибилдинг"],
  "Игровые виды":        ["футбол", "баскетбол", "волейбол", "настольный теннис", "хоккей", "хоккей с мячом"],
  "Лёгкая атлетика":     ["лёгкая атлетика"],
  "Водные виды":         ["плавание", "грудничковое плавание", "аквааэробика", "гидрореабилитация"],
  "Гимнастика и фитнес": ["художественная гимнастика", "развивающая гимнастика", "ритмическая гимнастика", "спортивная акробатика", "фитнес-аэробика"],
  "Черлидинг":           ["чир-фристайл", "чир-пом", "чир-перформанс"],
  "Зимние виды":         ["фигурное катание", "горнолыжный спорт"],
  "Стрельба":            ["стрельба из лука", "пулевая стрельба"]
};

const SCHOOLS = [
  {
    id: "lider", name: "Лидер", type: "municipal",
    desc: "Муниципальное учреждение с самым широким выбором секций в городе — от гимнастики и фигурного катания до хоккея и стрельбы.",
    photo: IMG.lider, pos: "50% 60%",
    link: "https://lider-neru.obr.sakha.gov.ru/",
    sports: [
      { n: "художественная гимнастика", min: 6,  t: "с 6 лет" },

/* ---------- Вспомогательное ---------- */
const $  = (s, r = document) => r.querySelector(s);
const $$ = (s, r = document) => [...r.querySelectorAll(s)];
const cap = s => s.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + s.slice(1);
const TYPE_LABEL = { municipal: "Муниципальное", private: "Частное" };
const esc = s => String(s).replace(/[&<>"']/g, c => ({ "&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;", '"': "&quot;", "'": "&#39;" }[c]));
const plural = (n, one, few, many) => { const m = n % 10, h = n % 100; return (m === 1 && h !== 11) ? one : (m >= 2 && m <= 4 && (h < 12 || h > 14)) ? few : many; };
const linkLabel = url => /vk\.(ru|com)/.test(url) ? "ВКонтакте" : /max\.ru/.test(url) ? "MAX" : "Сайт школы";
const getLinks = s => s.links || (s.link ? [{ label: linkLabel(s.link), url: s.link }] : []);
const photoHTML = s => s.photo
  ? `<img src="${s.photo}" alt="Фото: ${esc(s.name)}" loading="lazy" style="object-position:${s.pos || "50% 50%"}">`
  : `<div class="ph" role="img" aria-label="Фото пока нет"><span>${esc(s.name.trim().charAt(0))}</span><small>Фото появится позже</small></div>`;
const minOf = list => { const a = list.map(x => x.min).filter(v => v != null); return a.length ? Math.min(...a) : null; };

const state = { search: "", type: "all", age: null, sports: new Set(), mode: "any", sort: "name", cat: Object.keys(CATEGORIES)[0] };

/* Секция подходит под возраст */
const ageOk = (sp, age) => age == null || ((sp.min == null || age >= sp.min) && (sp.max == null || age <= sp.max));

/* ---------- Фильтрация ---------- */
function getFiltered() {
  const q = state.search.trim().toLowerCase();
  const res = SCHOOLS.filter(s => {
    if (q && !s.name.toLowerCase().includes(q)) return false;
    if (state.type !== "all" && s.type !== state.type) return false;
    if (!s.sports.length) return !state.sports.size;   // виды спорта в источнике не указаны
    const pool = s.sports.filter(sp => ageOk(sp, state.age));
    if (!pool.length) return false;
    if (state.sports.size) {
      const names = new Set(pool.map(sp => sp.n));
      const sel = [...state.sports];
      return state.mode === "all" ? sel.every(n => names.has(n)) : sel.some(n => names.has(n));
    }
    return true;
  });
  const sorters = {
    name:   (a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name, "ru"),
    sports: (a, b) => b.sports.length - a.sports.length || a.name.localeCompare(b.name, "ru"),
    age:    (a, b) => (minOf(a.sports) ?? 999) - (minOf(b.sports) ?? 999) || a.name.localeCompare(b.name, "ru")
  };
  return res.sort(sorters[state.sort]);
}

/* ---------- Отрисовка ---------- */
function renderHero() {
  const all = new Set(SCHOOLS.flatMap(s => s.sports.map(x => x.n)));
  const ns = SCHOOLS.length, nk = all.size;
  $("#heroLead").textContent =
    `В каталоге ${ns} ${plural(ns, "организация", "организации", "организаций")} и ${nk} ${plural(nk, "вид", "вида", "видов")} спорта. Выберите вид спорта и возраст — покажем, где набирают.`;
}

function renderPicker() {
  const counts = {};
  SCHOOLS.forEach(s => s.sports.forEach(sp => counts[sp.n] = (counts[sp.n] || 0) + 1));

  $("#tabs").innerHTML = Object.entries(CATEGORIES).map(([cat, list]) => {
    const picked = list.filter(n => state.sports.has(n)).length;
    const on = cat === state.cat;
    return `<button type="button" role="tab" class="tab ${on ? "on" : ""}" aria-selected="${on}" data-cat="${esc(cat)}">
      ${esc(cat)}${picked ? `<span class="tab__n">${picked}</span>` : ""}</button>`;
  }).join("");

  const list = CATEGORIES[state.cat].filter(n => counts[n]);
  $("#chips").innerHTML = list.map(n => {
    const on = state.sports.has(n);
    return `<button type="button" class="chip ${on ? "on" : ""}" data-sport="${esc(n)}" aria-pressed="${on}">
      ${esc(cap(n))}<small>${counts[n]}</small></button>`;
  }).join("");
}

function syncControls() {
  $$("#typeFilter button").forEach(b => { const on = b.dataset.value === state.type; b.classList.toggle("on", on); b.setAttribute("aria-checked", on); });
  $$("#matchMode button").forEach(b => { const on = b.dataset.value === state.mode; b.classList.toggle("on", on); b.setAttribute("aria-checked", on); });
  $("#age").value = state.age == null ? "" : state.age;
  $("#search").value = state.search;
  renderPicker();
}

function sportTags(s, limit = 7) {
  if (!s.sports.length) return `<span class="tag tag--more">Виды спорта не указаны</span>`;
  const pool = s.sports.filter(sp => ageOk(sp, state.age));
  const sorted = [...pool].sort((a, b) => state.sports.has(b.n) - state.sports.has(a.n));
  const shown = sorted.slice(0, limit), rest = sorted.length - shown.length;
  return shown.map(sp => `<span class="tag ${state.sports.has(sp.n) ? "hit" : ""}">${esc(cap(sp.n))}</span>`).join("")
       + (rest > 0 ? `<span class="tag tag--more">ещё ${rest}</span>` : "");
}

/* Возраст на «номере»: по выбранным видам спорта, если они есть */
function ageBadge(s) {
  let pool = s.sports.filter(sp => ageOk(sp, state.age));
  if (state.sports.size) { const f = pool.filter(sp => state.sports.has(sp.n)); if (f.length) pool = f; }
  const m = minOf(pool);
  const lab = m != null && pool.find(sp => sp.min === m && sp.minLabel);
  if (lab) return `<div class="age" title="Минимальный возраст набора"><small>от</small><b>${lab.minLabel.n}</b><span>${lab.minLabel.u}</span></div>`;
  const cap2 = state.sports.size ? "для выбранного спорта" : "в самой ранней секции";
  return m == null
    ? `<div class="age age--unknown" title="Возраст в источнике не указан"><b>?</b><span>уточняйте<br>у школы</span></div>`
    : `<div class="age" title="${cap2}"><small>от</small><b>${m}</b><span>${plural(m, "года", "лет", "лет")}</span></div>`;
}

function rowHTML(s, i) {
  const n = s.sports.length;
  return `
  <article class="row" data-id="${s.id}" tabindex="0" role="button" aria-label="Открыть: ${esc(s.name)}" style="--i:${i}">
    <div class="row__photo">${photoHTML(s)}</div>
    <div class="row__main">
      <div class="row__head">
        <h3>${esc(s.name)}</h3>
        <span class="kind kind--${s.type}">${TYPE_LABEL[s.type]}</span>
        <span class="row__n">${n ? `${n} ${plural(n, "секция", "секции", "секций")}` : "виды спорта уточняйте"}</span>
      </div>
      <p class="row__desc">${esc(s.desc)}</p>
      <div class="tags">${sportTags(s)}</div>
      <div class="row__actions">
        <span class="open">Открыть карточку</span>
        ${getLinks(s).map(l => `<a class="ext" href="${esc(l.url)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener" data-stop>${esc(l.label)}</a>`).join("")}
      </div>
    </div>
    ${ageBadge(s)}
  </article>`;
}

function render() {
  const list = getFiltered();
  $("#list").innerHTML = list.map(rowHTML).join("");
  $("#empty").hidden = list.length > 0;
  $("#count").innerHTML = list.length
    ? `<b>${list.length}</b> ${plural(list.length, "школа", "школы", "школ")} из ${SCHOOLS.length}`
    : `Ничего не найдено`;

  const tags = [];
  if (state.type !== "all") tags.push({ k: "type", t: TYPE_LABEL[state.type] });
  if (state.age != null) tags.push({ k: "age", t: `${state.age} ${plural(state.age, "год", "года", "лет")}` });
  state.sports.forEach(n => tags.push({ k: "sport", v: n, t: cap(n) }));
  if (state.search) tags.push({ k: "search", t: `«${state.search}»` });
  $("#activeTags").innerHTML = tags.map(x =>
    `<button type="button" class="active-tag" data-k="${x.k}" data-v="${esc(x.v || "")}" aria-label="Убрать: ${esc(x.t)}">${esc(x.t)}<i aria-hidden="true">×</i></button>`).join("");
}

/* ---------- Модальное окно ---------- */
function openModal(id) {
  const s = SCHOOLS.find(x => x.id === id); if (!s) return;
  const rows = s.sports.map(sp => `
    <li class="${state.sports.has(sp.n) ? "hit" : ""}">
      <span>${esc(cap(sp.n))}${sp.note ? ` <em>(${esc(sp.note)})</em>` : ""}</span>
      <b>${esc(sp.t)}</b>
    </li>`).join("");
  $("#modalBody").innerHTML = `
    <button class="modal__close" type="button" data-close aria-label="Закрыть">×</button>
    <div class="modal__photo">${photoHTML(s)}</div>
    <div class="modal__content">
      <span class="kind kind--${s.type}">${TYPE_LABEL[s.type]}</span>
      <h2>${esc(s.name)}</h2>
      <p class="modal__desc">${esc(s.desc)}</p>

      <h4>Секции и возраст набора</h4>
      <ul class="sport-list">${rows || `<li><span>В источнике виды спорта не указаны — уточняйте у клуба.</span></li>`}</ul>

      ${s.groups ? `<h4>Возрастные группы</h4><ul class="plain">${s.groups.map(g => `<li>${esc(g)}</li>`).join("")}</ul>` : ""}

      <h4>Контакты</h4>
      <ul class="contacts">
        ${s.address ? `<li>${esc(s.address)}, Нерюнгри</li>` : ""}
        ${s.phone ? `<li><a href="tel:${s.phone.replace(/[^\d+]/g, "")}">${esc(s.phone)}</a></li>` : ""}
        ${getLinks(s).map(l => `<li><a href="${esc(l.url)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">${esc(l.label)}</a></li>`).join("")}
        ${!s.address && !s.phone && !getLinks(s).length ? `<li>У школы нет сайта — информацию уточняйте на месте.</li>` : ""}
      </ul>
    </div>`;
  const m = $("#modal"); m.showModal(); m.scrollTop = 0;
  document.body.classList.add("no-scroll");
}

/* ---------- Сброс ---------- */
function resetAll() {
  Object.assign(state, { search: "", type: "all", age: null, mode: "any" });
  state.sports.clear();
  syncControls(); render();
}

/* ---------- События ---------- */
function setAge(v) {
  state.age = (v === "" || v == null || Number.isNaN(v)) ? null : Math.max(0, Math.min(99, v));
  $("#age").value = state.age == null ? "" : state.age;
  render();
}

function init() {
  renderHero(); syncControls();

  $("#search").addEventListener("input", e => { state.search = e.target.value; render(); });
  $("#sort").addEventListener("change", e => { state.sort = e.target.value; render(); });

  $("#typeFilter").addEventListener("click", e => { const b = e.target.closest("button"); if (!b) return; state.type = b.dataset.value; syncControls(); render(); });
  $("#matchMode").addEventListener("click", e => { const b = e.target.closest("button"); if (!b) return; state.mode = b.dataset.value; syncControls(); render(); });

  $("#age").addEventListener("input", e => { const v = e.target.value; state.age = v === "" ? null : Math.max(0, Math.min(99, parseInt(v, 10))); if (Number.isNaN(state.age)) state.age = null; render(); });
  $("#ageMinus").addEventListener("click", () => setAge(state.age == null ? 6 : state.age - 1));
  $("#agePlus").addEventListener("click",  () => setAge(state.age == null ? 6 : state.age + 1));

  $("#tabs").addEventListener("click", e => { const t = e.target.closest(".tab"); if (!t) return; state.cat = t.dataset.cat; renderPicker(); });
  $("#chips").addEventListener("click", e => {
    const c = e.target.closest(".chip"); if (!c) return;
    const n = c.dataset.sport;
    state.sports.has(n) ? state.sports.delete(n) : state.sports.add(n);
    renderPicker(); render();
  });

  $("#activeTags").addEventListener("click", e => {
    const t = e.target.closest(".active-tag"); if (!t) return;
    const { k, v } = t.dataset;
    if (k === "type") state.type = "all";
    if (k === "age") state.age = null;
    if (k === "sport") state.sports.delete(v);
    if (k === "search") state.search = "";
    syncControls(); render();
  });

  $("#resetBtn").addEventListener("click", resetAll);
  $("#emptyReset").addEventListener("click", resetAll);

  $("#list").addEventListener("click", e => { if (e.target.closest("[data-stop]")) return; const c = e.target.closest(".row"); if (c) openModal(c.dataset.id); });
  $("#list").addEventListener("keydown", e => { if ((e.key === "Enter" || e.key === " ") && e.target.classList.contains("row")) { e.preventDefault(); openModal(e.target.dataset.id); } });

  const modal = $("#modal");
  modal.addEventListener("click", e => { if (e.target === modal || e.target.closest("[data-close]")) modal.close(); });
  modal.addEventListener("close", () => document.body.classList.remove("no-scroll"));

  render();
}
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", init);

</script>
</body>
</html>
